title: Calligraphy
subtitle: 「書法／藝術書寫／裝飾性手寫」，要分清 handwriting、lettering、typography 三個相鄰概念。
description: 「書法／藝術書寫／裝飾性手寫」，要分清 handwriting、lettering、typography 三個相鄰概念。

words.meaning: 裝飾性手寫；美術字手寫
words.example: The invitation was written in elegant decorative handwriting.
words.exampleZh: 邀請卡以優雅的裝飾性手寫字書寫。

exercises.original: The wedding invitation was decorated with elegant calligraphy.
exercises.zh: 婚禮邀請卡以優雅的裝飾性手寫字點綴。
exercises.upgrade: The wedding invitation was decorated with elegant decorative handwriting.

options.explanation: 邀請卡上的手寫文字以視覺美感和裝飾為目的，和 calligraphy 的此處含義最接近。
typography 處理字體和排版，不一定是手寫，也不描述這種筆觸創作。
font 是可重複使用的一套字型，而不是這張邀請卡上的實際手寫藝術。
只表示一般字跡，沒有 elegant / decorative 的藝術要求。
街頭塗鴉的文化和使用場景與婚禮邀請卡不同。
簽名主要辨識身份，不能概括整張邀請卡的裝飾書寫。

exercises.original: The artist added calligraphy around the border of the card.
exercises.zh: 藝術家在卡片邊框加入裝飾性手寫。
exercises.upgrade: The artist added decorative handwriting around the border of the card.

options.explanation: 字型本身不是藝術家實際在卡片上手寫的內容。
around the border 表示文字用作視覺裝飾，語義很自然。
偏排版設計，不保證是手寫。
只說連筆風格，沒有說是藝術裝飾。
不是以文字字形為核心。

exercises.original: The menu uses hand-painted calligraphy for the dish names.
exercises.zh: 餐牌以手繪裝飾性書寫呈現菜名。
exercises.upgrade: The menu uses hand-painted decorative handwriting for the dish names.

options.explanation: 可以參與餐牌版面設計，但 hand-painted 明確表示不是單純排印。
可模仿手寫，但題目說的是實際 hand-painted 字。
dish names 被手繪成具裝飾效果的手寫文字。
不符餐牌的正式裝飾語境。
無法表達藝術與裝飾性。

words.meaning: 藝術字體；藝術化字母書寫
words.example: The poster features artistic lettering across the top.
words.exampleZh: 海報頂部採用了藝術化字體。

exercises.original: The poster combines illustration with bold calligraphy.
exercises.zh: 海報把插畫和醒目的藝術字體結合。
exercises.upgrade: The poster combines illustration with bold artistic lettering.

options.explanation: poster + bold visual letters 是典型藝術字設計語境。
沒有設計和視覺藝術意味。
若是預製字型才適合；原句 calligraphy 暗示手作字形。
雖可有 stylised letters，但不是一般海報藝術字的同義詞。
插畫和文字是兩種元素，不能把文字本身叫 painting。

exercises.original: The title was written in flowing calligraphy across the cover.
exercises.zh: 封面標題以流暢的藝術字體書寫。
exercises.upgrade: The title was written in flowing artistic lettering across the cover.

options.explanation: 可描述整體版式，但題目是 title 的藝術字形本身。
flowing title design 保留視覺藝術性。
flowing 可能連筆，但 cursive 不一定具有 calligraphy 的藝術目的。
若是手寫，font 並不準確。
letters 雖可被畫出，但 drawing 太廣。

exercises.original: She creates calligraphy for posters and shop signs.
exercises.zh: 她為海報和店舖招牌創作藝術字體。
exercises.upgrade: She creates artistic lettering for posters and shop signs.

options.explanation: 是設計整套可重複字型，不等於為單一海報／招牌創作 lettering。
posters and shop signs 是 lettering 的典型應用。
只有特定街頭藝術語境才適合。

words.example: Her beautiful handwriting made the card feel personal and special.
words.exampleZh: 她優美的字跡令卡片更有個人特色。

exercises.original: Everyone admired the calligraphy in her handwritten letter.
exercises.zh: 大家都欣賞她手寫信中的優美字跡。
exercises.upgrade: Everyone admired the beautiful handwriting in her handwritten letter.

options.explanation: handwritten letter + admired the writing 強調字跡優美，這裡不必把它當正式藝術門類。
手寫信不是使用可重複印刷字型。

exercises.original: His calligraphy makes even a simple note look elegant.
exercises.zh: 他的漂亮字跡令簡單便條也顯得優雅。
exercises.upgrade: His beautiful handwriting makes even a simple note look elegant.

options.explanation: 原句特別強調 elegant，不能用 ordinary 淡化美感。
simple note 這類日常文本中，描述字跡漂亮最自然。
可連筆但不必然漂亮或藝術。

exercises.original: The teacher praised her calligraphy on the handwritten card.
exercises.zh: 老師稱讚她手寫卡片上的漂亮字跡。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher praised her beautiful handwriting on the handwritten card.

options.explanation: 也合理，但本題重點是美感結果，beautiful handwriting 更直接。
praised + handwritten card 明確是漂亮字跡。

words.example: The old manuscript is written in fine handwriting.
words.exampleZh: 這份舊手稿以精美字跡書寫。

exercises.original: The manuscript is known for its fine calligraphy.
exercises.zh: 這份手稿以精美字跡聞名。
exercises.upgrade: The manuscript is known for its fine handwriting.

options.explanation: manuscript + carefully formed script 很適合較傳統的 fine handwriting。
手稿是實際書寫，不是字型檔。

exercises.original: Her calligraphy is small, precise and remarkably elegant.
exercises.zh: 她的字跡細小、精準而非常優雅。
exercises.upgrade: Her fine handwriting is small, precise and remarkably elegant.

options.explanation: 無法表達 precise and elegant 的品質。
fine 在此可表示精緻、優美、細緻的字跡。

exercises.original: The historical letter displays exceptionally fine calligraphy.
exercises.zh: 這封歷史書信展現格外精美的手寫字。
exercises.upgrade: The historical letter displays exceptionally fine handwriting.

options.explanation: 只表示連筆形式，不足以表達 exceptionally fine。
歷史書信不只包含簽名。
正好描述整封信精緻優美的字跡。

words.meaning: 書寫技巧；字跡；書法技巧
words.example: The course helps students improve their penmanship.
words.exampleZh: 課程幫助學生改善書寫技巧。

exercises.original: The class focuses on improving students' calligraphy and letter formation.
exercises.zh: 課堂集中改善學生的書寫技巧和字形。
exercises.upgrade: The class focuses on improving students' penmanship and letter formation.

options.explanation: improving + letter formation 是書寫技巧訓練的典型語境。
是排印／版面設計，不是學生手寫訓練。

exercises.original: Regular practice improved his calligraphy considerably.
exercises.zh: 定期練習大幅改善了他的書寫技巧。
exercises.upgrade: Regular practice improved his penmanship considerably.

options.explanation: 太廣，雖可成立，但 penmanship 更突出技巧品質。
regular practice improving skill 是直接搭配。

exercises.original: The school once gave formal lessons in calligraphy and neat writing.
exercises.zh: 學校過去曾正式教授書寫技巧和工整字跡。
exercises.upgrade: The school once gave formal lessons in penmanship and neat writing.

options.explanation: 是專業字型設計，不是一般學校練字。
學校教授 neat writing 的傳統語境非常自然。

words.example: The workshop teaches hand lettering for cards and posters.
words.exampleZh: 工作坊教授卡片和海報的手繪字技巧。

exercises.original: The workshop teaches modern calligraphy for greeting cards.
exercises.zh: 工作坊教授用於賀卡的現代手繪字。
exercises.upgrade: The workshop teaches modern hand lettering for greeting cards.

options.explanation: greeting cards + modern decorative letters 是 hand lettering 的典型用途。
目標不是製作一整套可重複字型。

exercises.original: She sells prints featuring colourful calligraphy and illustrations.
exercises.zh: 她售賣結合彩色手繪字和插畫的印刷作品。
exercises.upgrade: She sells prints featuring colourful hand lettering and illustrations.

options.explanation: 也可，但 colourful hand-created letters 更精準是 hand lettering。
prints + illustrations 的現代設計語境很吻合。

exercises.original: The designer uses calligraphy to create custom quotes by hand.
exercises.zh: 設計師以手繪字創作訂製語錄。
exercises.upgrade: The designer uses hand lettering to create custom quotes by hand.

options.explanation: 不一定用手繪製每個字母。
是建立可重複字體系統。
custom quotes by hand 正是 hand-lettering 工作方式。

words.example: The café sign uses elegant lettering inspired by traditional scripts.
words.exampleZh: 咖啡店招牌採用受傳統字體啟發的優雅藝術字。

exercises.original: The shop sign uses calligraphy inspired by old advertisements.
exercises.zh: 店舖招牌採用受舊廣告啟發的藝術字。
exercises.upgrade: The shop sign uses lettering inspired by old advertisements.

options.explanation: shop sign 的字形設計最自然屬 lettering 範疇。
招牌字通常是設計元素，不只是日常字跡。
可能是製作方式，但不能專指文字設計。
題目沒有說使用數碼字型檔。

exercises.original: The book cover features large gold calligraphy.
exercises.zh: 書封採用大型金色藝術字。
exercises.upgrade: The book cover features large gold lettering.

options.explanation: 可描述整體封面排版，但 large gold letters 本身可直接稱 lettering。
書封視覺字形設計非常自然。
若是預製字型才可，不能從原句確定。

exercises.original: Custom calligraphy gives the packaging a handmade feel.
exercises.zh: 訂製藝術字令包裝帶有手作感。
exercises.upgrade: Custom lettering gives the packaging a handmade feel.

options.explanation: 若為整套字型設計才適合。
缺少 custom design 的視覺意圖。
packaging + custom visual letters 是設計語境典型用法。
偏版式和字體系統，不一定手作。

words.meaning: 裝飾字體；裝飾性字母設計
words.example: The certificate has decorative lettering around the border.
words.exampleZh: 證書邊框附近採用了裝飾性字體。

exercises.original: The certificate uses calligraphy around the recipient's name.
exercises.zh: 證書在得獎者姓名周圍使用裝飾字體。
exercises.upgrade: The certificate uses decorative lettering around the recipient's name.

options.explanation: certificate + ornamental text 是最典型裝飾字用途。
可參與證書設計，但此處重點是裝飾性字形。

exercises.original: The restaurant menu uses ornate calligraphy for section headings.
exercises.zh: 餐牌用華麗裝飾字作各部分標題。
exercises.upgrade: The restaurant menu uses ornate decorative lettering for section headings.

options.explanation: 可能，但 ornate hand-crafted visual form 更適合 decorative lettering。
section headings + ornate 是直接線索。

exercises.original: The invitation includes floral calligraphy around the date.
exercises.zh: 邀請卡日期周圍有花卉風格裝飾字。
exercises.upgrade: The invitation includes floral decorative lettering around the date.

options.explanation: floral design 已超出普通手寫。
floral + invitation 是典型視覺裝飾用途。

words.example: The exhibition brings together traditional and modern script art.
words.exampleZh: 展覽匯集傳統與現代字體藝術。

exercises.original: The exhibition explores calligraphy from several cultural traditions.
exercises.zh: 展覽探索多種文化傳統的書寫藝術。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition explores script art from several cultural traditions.

options.explanation: exhibition + several cultural traditions 把字體／書寫作為藝術媒介，適合描述性表達。
主要屬字體排版設計，不能概括文化書法藝術。
雖文化藝術可能相關，但不是文字書寫藝術。

exercises.original: The museum displays both historical and contemporary calligraphy.
exercises.zh: 博物館展出歷史和當代字體藝術。
exercises.upgrade: The museum displays both historical and contemporary script art.

options.explanation: 也有視覺字形，但 museum cultural-art framing 更適合 script art。
historical and contemporary written-form art 都可涵蓋。
不符實體／手寫藝術作品。
只是一種特定街頭藝術。

exercises.original: Students study calligraphy as a visual art form.
exercises.zh: 學生把書法作為視覺藝術形式學習。
exercises.upgrade: Students study script art as a visual art form.

options.explanation: 日常字跡不一定是 visual art form。
是另一門視覺設計學科。
明確把書寫字形視為藝術。
太專門於可重複字型系統。

words.example: Calligraphy is often described as the art of beautiful handwriting.
words.exampleZh: 書法常被形容為優美手寫的藝術。

exercises.original: Calligraphy is often described as beautiful writing made into an art.
exercises.zh: 書法常被形容為把優美書寫提升成藝術。
exercises.upgrade: Calligraphy is often described as the art of beautiful handwriting.

options.explanation: 這是 calligraphy 最透明、準確的教學釋義之一。

exercises.original: The course introduces calligraphy as a traditional visual art.
exercises.zh: 課程把書法介紹為傳統視覺藝術。
exercises.upgrade: The course introduces the art of handwriting as a traditional visual art.

options.explanation: 偏技能／字跡質素，未必等於完整藝術形式。
traditional visual art 的解釋性重寫自然。

exercises.original: She teaches calligraphy to beginners who want to make beautiful handwritten work.
exercises.zh: 她向希望創作優美手寫作品的初學者教授書法。
exercises.upgrade: She teaches the art of handwriting to beginners who want to make beautiful handwritten work.

options.explanation: 只是一般書寫，不足以表達教學的藝術目的。
beginner + beautiful handwritten work 很適合作透明解釋。

words.example: She studies traditional Chinese brush calligraphy.
words.exampleZh: 她學習傳統中國毛筆書法。

exercises.original: She studies traditional Chinese calligraphy using ink and a brush.
exercises.zh: 她以墨和毛筆學習傳統中國書法。
exercises.upgrade: She studies traditional Chinese brush calligraphy using ink and a brush.

options.explanation: ink + brush + Chinese tradition 明確限定為毛筆書法。
可手作，但通常不專指中國毛筆書法傳統。

exercises.original: The class teaches calligraphy with traditional brushes.
exercises.zh: 課堂教授以傳統毛筆進行書法創作。
exercises.upgrade: The class teaches brush calligraphy with traditional brushes.

options.explanation: 太一般，沒有 brush 工具限定。
雖也可用毛筆，但題目核心是文字書寫。

exercises.original: Her calligraphy practice focuses on brush pressure and ink flow.
exercises.zh: 她的書法練習集中於毛筆壓力和墨水流動。
exercises.upgrade: Her brush calligraphy practice focuses on brush pressure and ink flow.

options.explanation: 也不特指 brush pressure/ink flow。
兩項技術線索都直接屬毛筆書法。

words.meaning: 傳統字體書寫；傳統書藝
words.example: The course introduces traditional script writing and brush control.
words.exampleZh: 課程介紹傳統字體書寫和運筆控制。

exercises.original: The course explores calligraphy in several historical writing styles.
exercises.zh: 課程探索多種歷史書體的傳統書寫。
exercises.upgrade: The course explores traditional script writing in several historical styles.

options.explanation: historical writing styles + established tradition 最吻合。

exercises.original: Students learn calligraphy according to established script conventions.
exercises.zh: 學生按既定書體規範學習書法。
exercises.upgrade: Students learn traditional script writing according to established script conventions.

options.explanation: 可指書寫技巧，但沒有 established script conventions 的文化規範意味。
明確對應傳統書體規則。
太廣，也不必遵循傳統 script。

exercises.original: The manuscript reflects centuries of calligraphy tradition.
exercises.zh: 手稿反映數百年的傳統書藝。
exercises.upgrade: The manuscript reflects centuries of traditional script writing.

options.explanation: 無法表達 centuries of tradition。
historical manuscript + centuries of tradition 完全吻合。
只是一種 script style，不代表整個傳統。

words.example: The document uses ornamental writing for the opening lines.
words.exampleZh: 文件開首幾行採用裝飾性書寫。

exercises.original: The certificate uses elaborate calligraphy in its opening lines.
exercises.zh: 證書開首幾行採用華麗裝飾性書寫。
exercises.upgrade: The certificate uses elaborate ornamental writing in its opening lines.

options.explanation: elaborate + certificate 表示華麗裝飾性文字。
可能涉及版式，但不能專指手寫裝飾筆觸。

exercises.original: The invitation is covered in floral calligraphy.
exercises.zh: 邀請卡上滿是花卉風格的裝飾性書寫。
exercises.upgrade: The invitation is covered in floral ornamental writing.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 floral + elaborate decorative script 很適合 ornamental writing。
強調華麗、裝飾性的手寫形式。
花卉可能被畫出，但題目說的是文字。

exercises.original: The manuscript uses calligraphy mainly for decorative headings.
exercises.zh: 手稿主要在裝飾標題中使用書法。
exercises.upgrade: The manuscript uses ornamental writing mainly for decorative headings.

options.explanation: 缺少 decorative headings 的美術目的。
decorative headings 正是其最典型用途。
手稿不一定使用印刷字型。

falseSynonyms.zh: 字體排印不等於 calligraphy typography 是選擇、排列和設計可重複使用的字體與文字版面；calligraphy 是以手寫筆勢形成字形的藝術。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Typography arranges type; calligraphy creates letterforms through writing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 字型不等於書法 font 是可重複使用的一套數碼／印刷字形；calligraphy 通常是手寫創作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A font is a reusable type design; calligraphy is handwritten or hand-executed lettering.

falseSynonyms.zh: 普通手寫過於寬泛 任何人寫字都是 handwriting；只有具有藝術、技巧或美學目的時才接近 calligraphy。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON All calligraphy is handwriting in a broad sense, but ordinary handwriting is not necessarily calligraphy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 草寫／連筆不等於 calligraphy cursive 是一種連筆書寫方式；calligraphy 可以用 cursive，也可以使用非連筆字體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cursive describes a writing style; calligraphy describes an artistic practice.

falseSynonyms.zh: 繪畫不等於書法 drawing 以圖像和線條表現物件／形狀；calligraphy 的核心媒介是文字與字形。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Calligraphy may be visually expressive, but it remains centred on written forms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 繪畫不等於 calligraphy 某些文化中書畫關係密切，但 painting 和 calligraphy 是不同藝術形式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Painting creates images; calligraphy creates artistic written forms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 簽名不等於書法 簽名可以很有藝術感，但它的主要功能是身份標記，不等於整門書法藝術。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A signature may use calligraphic style without being synonymous with calligraphy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 塗鴉不等於書法 graffiti 可以包含藝術文字，但通常指公共空間的塗寫／街頭藝術；和 calligraphy 的傳統、技法與用途不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Graffiti can include stylised lettering, but it is a different artistic and social practice.
